decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks sit within the firm's core thermoforming consumables range, cost little to keep listed, and have a dedicated page, so after one year the option is worth keeping open.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a low-cost extension of an established material line with its own page, and its prospects are still unresolved, so keeping the option is cheap.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, so its value is less proven, but carrying a consumable costs little and one year is too early to judge, so it stays for now.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's push into digital scanning workflows and has its own page, so it is a strategically aligned option worth holding while uncertainty resolves.
Custom earmolds rely on the firm's core custom-device manufacturing and hearing-care channel, so the cost of keeping them is low despite their modest website presence.
Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold production capabilities and opens a growth segment, so with uncertainty still high and carrying costs low the option is kept.
